title: AI Act Compliance Agent: Shield Your SMB From Fines
body:
Did you know that your OpenAI chatbot could cost you thousands of dollars in fines due to the new Artificial Intelligence Act?

Small businesses and freelancers are integrating LLMs into their websites without any legal control. The European AI Act regulation is already in force and demands absolute traceability, data logging, and explicit warnings to the user. Otherwise, you face toxic sanctions that can bankrupt your B2B or B2C business.

The trap of basic legal prompts

Many developers believe they solve compliance by adding a line in the system prompt telling the AI to be transparent. This fails because models suffer from hallucinations and do not keep an auditable record of input and output data required by the EU. A simple warning inside the chat will not protect you during an inspection by the Supervisory Authority.

Our solution: AI Act Compliance Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO we have designed a serverless technical layer that audits and records immutably every interaction of your corporate bots, guaranteeing compliance without penalizing performance.

  1. Immutable log registration: We store the hashes of the interactions in a secure database for fast audits.
  2. Perimeter privacy filter: We obfuscate personal data automatically before it reaches third-party APIs.
  3. B2B transparency guarantee: We inject dynamic metadata to ensure the end user always knows what is artificial.
  4. Technical bias control: We evaluate responses in milliseconds, automatically blocking high-risk outputs.

The Real Impact on Regulatory Compliance

  • Zero risk of sanctions: You permanently shield your platform against European artificial intelligence regulation fines.
  • Verified commercial trust: You get a digital transparency seal that opens doors with large B2B corporations.
  • Savings on legal consulting: You automate technical audit work without paying abusive monthly fees.
